NOTICES — AROUND THE CLUB

**Twilight sessions** Tuesday twilight sessions resume from the 19th, lights permitting, and will run until the clocks change. Bring a torch for the walk back to the car park.
**The ladder** The committee is seeking a volunteer to keep the ladder. It takes about an hour a week and a tolerance for arguments about rounding.
**Lost property** Three left gloves, a thermos, and a single boule of unknown ownership. Unclaimed items go to the jumble stall at the end of the month.
**Bar rota** The bar rota for October is pinned by the kettle. Anyone who has not yet done a shift is on it twice.
**Subs** Subscriptions are due by the end of the month; the treasurer takes cash, cheques and, grudgingly, bank transfers.
